# Featured Projects

## 🎨 UX / UI Design Projects

### Star Charge Web Config Tool
Simplified a Web Configuration Tool allowing B2B customers to edit fields related to electrical vehicle charging.

### Depop Redesign
A complete redesign of Depop’s Home and Profile pages, rooted in competitor analysis, user testing, and visual consistency.  

### BeReal Case Study
Identified key pain points for a social media app that encourages authenticity through surveys and usability testing. 

---

## 📊 Data Science & Analytics Projects

### Exploring Female Representation in MoMA
A full data-storytelling project analyzing over 157k art records using R, Tableau, and WordPress.  

### Star Charge Log Analysis Tool
Developed tool that generates data visualizations for charging sessions of log files with 300k+ records, allowing users to filter by charging step and other attributes.

### Mapping Spotify User Listening Data
Built a data pipeline and interactive visualization of personal listening history using SQL, Python, and BeautifulSoup.
